summary: Lists Windows limitations: Ansible cannot upgrade PowerShell or interact with WinRM listeners, because both break the connection. async or scheduled tasks can technically work but are fragile; do it during bootstrapping or image building.
questions: Can I upgrade PowerShell on Windows hosts with Ansible?
Can Ansible reconfigure WinRM listeners on a host?
Why does my connection drop when changing WinRM with a playbook?

answer_card.title: Things Ansible can't do on Windows
answer_card.answer_md: Ansible can't reliably **upgrade PowerShell** or **interact with WinRM listeners**, because both break the WinRM connection Ansible is using. `async` or a scheduled task can technically work around it, but it's fragile. Do these during bootstrapping or before building the image.
